tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and lists. The app's ground in both apps.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, sheets, the tab bar. Text: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `ink-subtle`.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Inset fills on `surface`: segmented-control track, input wells, keypad keys, skeletons.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of rows and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards (decorative, not a control border).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, secondary buttons, unselected chips. 3:1 on `surface` and `canvas`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and money figures, on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-muted` and every `*-soft` fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, labels, paise after the rupee figure. On `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-muted`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, disabled labels. 4.5:1 on `surface` and `canvas`; avoid on `surface-muted`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed backdrop behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: fincrew
tokens.usage: FinCrew accent ("Peacock"). Primary button fill, active tab, links and selected states in the owner app. As text, on `surface` and `canvas`.

tokens.name: fincrew-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a `fincrew` fill.

tokens.name: fincrew-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind `fincrew` text: selected chip, active tab pill, header band.

tokens.name: on-fincrew
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `fincrew` fill.

tokens.name: staffora
tokens.usage: Staffora accent ("Marigold"). Primary button fill, active tab pill, the check-in hero in the staff app. A fill only: never text on a light ground (use `staffora-ink`).

tokens.name: staffora-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a `staffora` fill.

tokens.name: staffora-ink
tokens.usage: Staffora accent as text and icons (links, selected tab label) on `surface` and `canvas`.

tokens.name: staffora-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind `staffora-ink` text.

tokens.name: on-staffora
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `staffora` fill. Always dark ink, in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The current app's accent fill. FinCrew by default; inside `.app-staffora` it becomes `staffora`. Components use this, never an app token directly.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed state of an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted accent fill (selected chip, active tab pill).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: The current app's accent as text/icon on `surface` and `canvas`. FinCrew: `fincrew`; Staffora: `staffora-ink`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: status-present
tokens.usage: Present: icon and label colour of the status, on `surface`, `canvas` and `status-present-soft`. Calendar day icon, pill text, widget figure.

tokens.name: status-present-soft
tokens.usage: Present: pill and calendar-cell fill. Text on it: `status-present` or `ink`.

tokens.name: status-half-day
tokens.usage: Half day: icon and label colour of the status, on `surface`, `canvas` and `status-half-day-soft`. Calendar day icon, pill text, widget figure.

tokens.name: status-half-day-soft
tokens.usage: Half day: pill and calendar-cell fill. Text on it: `status-half-day` or `ink`.

tokens.name: status-absent
tokens.usage: Absent: icon and label colour of the status, on `surface`, `canvas` and `status-absent-soft`. Calendar day icon, pill text, widget figure.

tokens.name: status-absent-soft
tokens.usage: Absent: pill and calendar-cell fill. Text on it: `status-absent` or `ink`.

tokens.name: status-paid-leave
tokens.usage: Paid leave: icon and label colour of the status, on `surface`, `canvas` and `status-paid-leave-soft`. Calendar day icon, pill text, widget figure.

tokens.name: status-paid-leave-soft
tokens.usage: Paid leave: pill and calendar-cell fill. Text on it: `status-paid-leave` or `ink`.

tokens.name: status-unpaid-leave
tokens.usage: Unpaid leave: icon and label colour of the status, on `surface`, `canvas` and `status-unpaid-leave-soft`. Calendar day icon, pill text, widget figure.

tokens.name: status-unpaid-leave-soft
tokens.usage: Unpaid leave: pill and calendar-cell fill. Text on it: `status-unpaid-leave` or `ink`.

tokens.name: status-weekly-off
tokens.usage: Weekly off: icon and label colour of the status, on `surface`, `canvas` and `status-weekly-off-soft`. Calendar day icon, pill text, widget figure.

tokens.name: status-weekly-off-soft
tokens.usage: Weekly off: pill and calendar-cell fill. Text on it: `status-weekly-off` or `ink`.

tokens.name: status-holiday
tokens.usage: Holiday: icon and label colour of the status, on `surface`, `canvas` and `status-holiday-soft`. Calendar day icon, pill text, widget figure.

tokens.name: status-holiday-soft
tokens.usage: Holiday: pill and calendar-cell fill. Text on it: `status-holiday` or `ink`.

tokens.name: status-late
tokens.usage: Late: icon and label colour of the status, on `surface`, `canvas` and `status-late-soft`. Calendar day icon, pill text, widget figure.

tokens.name: status-late-soft
tokens.usage: Late: pill and calendar-cell fill. Text on it: `status-late` or `ink`.

tokens.name: status-unmarked
tokens.usage: Not marked yet (a UI state, not a stored status): dashed outline and label colour.

tokens.name: money-owed
tokens.usage: Money the shop still owes a person (balance due, unpaid salary). Amber = waiting. Always with the word "Due".

tokens.name: money-paid
tokens.usage: Money settled (salary paid, payment out). Green = done. Always with "Paid" or a check.

tokens.name: money-advance
tokens.usage: Advance given that the person will repay. Blue = on account. Always with "Advance".

tokens.name: money-deduction
tokens.usage: Deductions on payslips (late, unpaid days): shown with a minus sign in muted ink, never red.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors (delete, reject, failed check-in).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger` fill.

families.sans: "Anek Latin", "Anek Tamil", "Anek Devanagari", "Noto Sans Tamil", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif
families.num: "Anek Latin", "Anek Tamil", "Anek Devanagari", "Noto Sans Tamil", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif
families.ta: "Anek Tamil", "Anek Latin", "Anek Tamil", "Anek Devanagari", "Noto Sans Tamil", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif
families.hi: "Anek Devanagari", "Anek Latin", "Anek Tamil", "Anek Devanagari", "Noto Sans Tamil", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: money-hero
styles.usage: The one number a screen is about: balance due, month total, net pay. Tabular figures, font-stretch 110%. Paise drop to `money-md` size in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: money-lg
styles.usage: Amount input, payslip net line, card totals. Tabular figures.

styles.name: money-md
styles.usage: Ledger and list amounts, summary chip counts. Tabular figures.

styles.name: money-sm
styles.usage: Running balance, payslip line amounts, inline figures in text. Tabular figures.

styles.name: code-digits
styles.usage: The 6-digit attendance code and code-pad slots. Tabular figures, two groups of three.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Screen title on tab roots (Today, Staff, Money, Home).

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Sheet titles, staff name on staff detail.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Primary row text, sheet body, empty-state body. The default size in Staffora.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body text in FinCrew, meta lines under names.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Large button labels, staff names in rows.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Medium button labels, segmented control, chip labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Pills, timestamps, helper text, ledger notes.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Tab-bar labels and calendar weekday headers only. Never smaller than 12px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills, chips and inline items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, gap between avatar and text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Large-button horizontal padding, sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a hero money figure; section breaks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of a screen title on tab roots.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Calendar cells, small tags, code-slot inner corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, keypad keys, segmented-control thumb.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero cards (balance, today summary), app-icon tiles in previews.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, late badge, active-tab pill.

shadow.note: Elevation is quiet: light theme uses soft shadows, dark theme uses a 1px light edge instead (shadows vanish on dark grounds).

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped lists resting on `canvas`.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Floating things: tab bar, sticky action footer, the selected summary chip.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs, over `scrim`.

size.note: Touch sizes for one-handed use on the shop floor.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target anywhere (chips, quiet buttons, list actions).

tokens.name: tap-primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and the check-in options.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Staff rows and ledger lines.

tokens.name: keypad-key
tokens.usage: Code-pad and amount keypad keys.

tokens.name: tab-bar
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height (plus the device safe area).

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Staff photo in rows.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default icon size; always paired with a visible label.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside pills and badges.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the phone column when a phone layout is shown on the web.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons and keys (keep the label readable; never the only signal).
